summary: Deadline Games' Mexico-set stunt-shooter line, pairing the original Total Overdose with PSP follow-up/remake Chili Con Carnage.

entries.title: Total Overdose

emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; emulate PS2/Xbox only for original-platform comparison.

primary.why: Total Overdose released for Windows, PlayStation 2, and Xbox. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the original open-world shooter.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively with compatibility fixes if needed; use PS2 or Xbox only for original-console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.

entries.title: Chili Con Carnage

emulation.notes: Original PSP hardware is the reference route; PPSSPP can upscale for preservation.

primary.why: Chili Con Carnage released exclusively for PlayStation Portable and is often described as both a sequel and remake of Total Overdose. PSP is the only sourced release and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PSP hardware or use PPSSPP with owned media for higher-resolution preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
